channel.title: Side Quest Co - Dungeon Crawler Carl Gifts

item.title: Jamal Hammerhead Shark Figurine, a Dungeon Crawler Carl Gift
item.description: Know someone who has read Dungeon Crawler Carl more than once? This is Jamal, the hammerhead shark, as a decorative figure for their shelf, desk or display cabinet. We make each one to order here in Canada, printed in PLA plastic in our small shop. It's an easy gift for the DCC fan who already has the books lined up and wants something to sit beside them.

item.title: Mongo and Princess Donut Figure for a Dungeon Crawler Carl Bookshelf
item.description: Mongo and Princess Donut, sitting on the shelf next to the books they came from. This is a decorative figure for fans of Dungeon Crawler Carl, made to order by our small shop in Canada and printed in PLA. It fits in on a bookshelf, a desk or a display cabinet, and it makes a good gift for the reader in your life who keeps telling you to start the series.

item.title: Princess Donut Figure for a Dungeon Crawler Carl Bookshelf
item.description: Princess Donut, sitting on the shelf right next to the books she came from. This is a decorative figure for display, and she suits a bookshelf, a desk or a display cabinet. item.title: Princess Donut Figure, a Gift for the Dungeon Crawler Carl Fan in Your Life
item.description: If someone you know has read Dungeon Crawler Carl, they already have opinions about Princess Donut. This is a small decorative figure of her, made for a shelf, a desk or a display cabinet, right next to the books where she belongs. We make each one to order here in Canada, in PLA, as a small shop. A good pick when you want to give a fan something that shows you were paying attention.
